summary.name: Nimclip
summary.one_liner: Nimclip is a free, open-source, native macOS clipboard history manager that keeps all data local on the Mac.
use_cases: recall recently copied text, links, code or images
search past clipboard items including text recognized in images
paste as plain text without formatting
merge several clipboard items into one paste
keep clipboard data private on a single Mac
summary.what_it_does: Nimclip records clipboard history for text, links, code, images and rich text, and shows the source application name and icon for each item. Users can search history, filter by type, mark favorites, and add tags; images can be found by text recognized in them. It supports plain-text paste and merging multiple items, with configurable retention count and time, a global shortcut, and appearance settings. When the limit is reached, the oldest non-favorite entries are removed automatically. Image OCR uses macOS system OCR running on-device at low priority.
notable: Local-first: all clipboard data stays on the Mac, no account or cloud upload
Image text recognition via macOS system OCR, on-device
Checks for updates after launch and every 10 minutes, without repeat reminders for the same version
